summary: Conditionally applies three scale factors to three groups of float fields on the receiver object, gated on bit 1 of the flags dword at this+0x0. When the bit is set it clears it and multiplies group A (this+0x28/+0x2C/+0x30) by scale factor this+0x1C, group B (this+0x38/+0x3C/+0x40) by this+0x20, and group C (this+0x48/+0x4C/+0x50) by this+0x24. Returns the original flags value read at entry, regardless of whether scaling ran.

local_names.this: float receiver object; this+0x0 holds a flags dword whose bit 1 is the scale-pending flag
local_names.result: the flags dword value read at entry (return value)

operations.description: Reads the flags dword this+0x0; executes the scaling block only when bit 1 is set (value & 2 != 0)
Clears bit 1 of the flags dword and writes the updated value back to this+0x0, so the scale is applied once
Scales group A by factor this+0x1C: this+0x28 = this+0x1C*this+0x28, this+0x2C = this+0x1C*this+0x2C, this+0x30 = this+0x1C*this+0x30
Scales group B by factor this+0x20: this+0x38, this+0x3C and this+0x40 each multiplied by this+0x20
Scales group C by factor this+0x24: this+0x48, this+0x4C and this+0x50 each multiplied by this+0x24
Returns the original flags dword read at entry (before bit 1 was cleared)
